title: Welcome to NBAA 2022
body_markdown:
CAE is happy to welcome you at booth#3935 for NBAA 2022! Drop by our booth to see how CAE is investing in the future of business aviation.


Can't make it in person? Keep up with our latest news on social media and view all news from the show on our dedicated event page:[https://www.cae.com/nbaa-2022/](https://www.cae.com/nbaa-2022/)
